subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Tris(acetylacetonato)chromium（Cr(acac)₃）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal bipyramidal
D. Trigonal planar
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Cr (group 6) 6 e; 3 × acac (LX) 9 e: 15 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −3 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Cr(III), d³; d³ + 12 e from the ligands = 15 e.
